name: Create Deco 2.0.2-1.20.1-forge
changelog:
# New Features
- Updated door textures
- Added Brick Wall blocks
- Reverted Long Bricks textures
- Tweaked supports blocks textures
- Added Corner Bricks blocks (previous long bricks texture)
- Metal bars are now transparent to fans
- Made decals and cage lamps wrenchable

# Bug Fixes
- Fixed Hull z-fighting
- Fixed railing wrenching crashing the server
- Fixed crash with computers running certain languages
- Implemented many tweaks and fixes from pull requests

name: Create Deco 2.0.1-1.20.1-forge
changelog:
### New Features:
- Supported Catwalks (catwalks will now have a special model when placed on top of a Support block so they look as if they are connected

### Bug Fixes:
- Window tag issue has been resolved
- Create Deco is now compatible with the create sodium fix fork
- Catwalks are now properly waterloggable
- Gold and Netherite coin stacks are no long unplaceble
- an edge case where some blocks had the wrong data value in certain countries has been resolved

name: Create Deco 2.0.0-1.20.1
changelog:
# !!!IMPORTANT!!! This version includes a major rework as part of it updating to 1.20.1 meaning that if you update an old version of this mod, you will experience errors or missing blocks in your world, use at own risk.

On a lighter note:
- added support wedges
- added railings separate from catwalks
- reworked decals
- added verdant bricks
- added shipping containers
- added windows
- removed netherite and gold sets
- removed brick items
